rules.instruction: When the description states that choosing one of several alternatives, such as accepting one of several arriving alternatives, makes the other still-open alternatives void, so the choice has a consequence for the remaining ones: After the decision that selects one alternative, model an explicit task on the selected path that voids or withdraws the other still-open alternatives, placed before the process continues. Do not leave the consequence implicit, and do not model it as a flow from the decision to an end event, because the description states an action that must be carried out.

rules.instruction: When the description states that several distinct actions are carried out in parallel (for example, items are sent in parallel), or that a set of distinct actions must all be completed before the process continues: Model a parallel gateway that forks into one outgoing branch per action, so that all branches start, and a parallel gateway that joins those branches before the next step.
